logic: The SPAYD text of a payment QR that GET /api/donations/payment-qr answers for the foundation's account (QrPayment.toSpayd), and the refusals of its invalid parameters as the problem's status, type and the fields it names; the recipient cases come from GeneratePaymentQrService with another account. From slice 1.2 the backend runs every case through SpaydText, and from 1.4 the browser runs them through spayd(); 1.4 removes the endpoint, so it rewrites each refusal as the refusal that SpaydText and spayd() share. qr/payment.json encodes each text into its QR symbol under the same case name
